# reselling_images (Data Source)

Custom images visible to the account (own images and, for a sub-reseller, images shared by the main reseller).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_images" "golden" {
  name = "golden"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only images whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `labels` (List of String)
- `location_id` (String)
- `min_disk_gb` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `os_version_id` (String)
- `owned` (Boolean)
- `size_gb` (Number)
- `status` (String)
